title: Real-World: Contact Form for a Small Business
prompt:
A local business needs a contact form. Build it accessibly.

Requirements:
- A `<form>` containing the controls.
- A labeled email input (`type="email"`, with a `<label for>` wired to its `id`, and `required`).
- A labeled `<select>` with at least two `<option>`s.
- A labeled `<textarea>` for the message.
- A `<button type="submit">` with visible text.

tests.name: has a form
tests.hint: Everything a visitor fills in lives inside <form>…</form>.

tests.name: email input has type email and a name
tests.hint: <input type="email" name="email"> — the type gives mobile keyboards the @ key.

tests.name: email input is labeled correctly
tests.hint: Pair <label for="email"> with the input's id="email" — that link is what screen readers announce.

tests.name: email input is required
tests.hint: Add the required attribute to the email input — the browser blocks empty submission.

tests.name: select with options
select has a label
tests.hint: Selects need labels exactly like inputs: <label for="topic">.

tests.name: textarea with a label
tests.hint: Multi-line messages belong in <textarea>; give it an id and a matching label.

tests.name: submit button with text
tests.hint: <button type="submit">Send message</button> — real text, not an icon alone.
